name: Guangzhou Risong Intelligent Technology Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Risong Intelligent Technology Holding Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, manufacture, and sale of robots, industrial software, and intelligent manufacturing products in China and internationally. The company offers industrial robots, such as SCARA, grinding, and parallel robots, as well as remote laser robot systems; and intelligent welding equipment, including gantry friction stir welding, c-type friction stir welding, robot stir friction welding, laser scribing machine, and 8-axis robot welding systems for new materials.
